title: Hearty Beef Tunisian Beef Stew
description: A rich, cheese-pull stew originating from Tunisia, featuring tender beef, a blend of spices, and a hint of citrus. Perfect for a hangover cure or a comforting meal after a long day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a 3-quart terracotta dish over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and red bell pepper to the terracotta dish and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the terracotta dish and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and harissa to the terracotta dish and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the terracotta dish and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the terracotta dish to the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the terracotta dish from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10-15 minutes before serving to allow the cheese to pull.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
If desired, serve with crusty bread or over couscous for a filling meal.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
